title: Failing to Make the Grade: Conventional Cardiac Allograft Rejection Grading Criteria Are Inadequate for Predicting Rejection Severity
study_context: Cardiac biopsy grade versus clinically evident rejection.
population_or_data: Retrospective endomyocardial biopsy images and clinical trajectory labels.
task: Cardiac biopsy grade versus clinically evident rejection.
main_findings: Morphology associated with conventional grades differs from morphology associated with clinical injury.
limitations: Clinical trajectory classification is a different target from our pathology-label classifier.
Review covers the cited pages; quantitative tables require further source verification.
does_not_establish: No proof our pathology-label model predicts future rejection or clinical benefit.
relevance_to_project: State clearly what predicting ACR/AMR grades establishes.
